Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::createLoanAccount(loanaccountid: Integer,balance: Real,status: LoanAccountStatus[NORMAL|HASPAIDINFULL]): Boolean {
	definition:
		existAccount: LoanAccount = LoanAccount.allInstance()->any(o|o.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid)
	precondition:
		loanaccountid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		balance.oclIsTypeOf(Real) and
		status.oclIsTypeOf(LoanAccountStatus) and
		LoanAccount.allInstance()->isUnique(o: LoanAccount|o.LoanAccountID)
	postcondition:
		if existAccount.oclIsUndefined() 
		then let newAccount: LoanAccount in
		newAccount.oclIsNew() and
		LoanAccount.allInstance()->includes(newAccount) and
		newAccount.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid and
		newAccount.Balance = balance and
		newAccount.Status = status and
		result = true 
		else result = false 
		endif 
}
